name: hornero
description: Role-and-skill methodology for Claude Code: 7 reviewer subagents, 7 slash commands, and ~60 expert-grounded skills across software-engineer, product-manager, designer, tester, security-expert, marketing-expert, and data-scientist roles. Dispatcher protocol routes prompts to the right role-skill pair; per-role skills are exposed at the plugin-loader's flat `skills/<name>` layout via build-time symlinks.
